captions.caption: A yellow Galion grader is parked in a wooded area with burnt trees.
The yellow grader begins moving forward, pushing through some brush.
The grader continues its slow movement across the uneven ground.
A silver pickup truck with its hood open is visible in the background.
The yellow grader moves slowly through the clearing, with the truck behind it.
The operator is visible in the cab of the grader as it moves.
The yellow Galion grader continues to traverse the grassy and sandy field.
The camera pans to follow the side profile of the grader as it moves.
The grader's blade is raised as it moves across the uneven terrain.
The yellow grader moves past the camera, showing its large rear wheels.
A person in a black shirt is briefly visible as the grader moves away.
The yellow grader continues moving forward through the field.
The side of the yellow Galion T-400 grader is shown as it moves.
The grader moves slowly across the field towards some distant trees.
The operator steers the yellow grader through the wooded clearing.
The camera maintains a side view of the grader as it continues moving.
Another person is seen standing in the distance as the grader passes.
A red pickup truck is visible in the foreground as the grader moves.
The yellow grader continues its slow progress past the red truck.
The grader moves further into the open area, away from the camera.
The operator in the cab of the yellow grader is seen from the side.
The yellow grader moves towards some leaning pine trees in the field.
The camera tracks the grader's movement across the grassy terrain.
The yellow Galion grader continues its slow, steady path through the clearing.
The grader's large tires turn as it moves over the brushy ground.
The grader moves further away, with more trees visible in the background.
The camera follows the yellow grader as it continues across the field.
The yellow grader is seen moving slowly under a cloudy sky.
The grader continues to move forward, its yellow paint clearly visible.
The camera pans to keep the yellow grader in the frame.
The yellow grader moves across the field with its blade underneath.
The grader continues its slow progress, kicking up a bit of dust.
The yellow Galion T-400 grader is shown from a side view.
The grader moves towards an area with more sand and less grass.
The operator continues to drive the yellow grader across the clearing.
A white pickup truck is visible in the distance as the grader moves.
The yellow grader moves closer to the white truck parked in the field.
The yellow Galion grader comes to a complete stop in the clearing.
The grader sits stationary in the field after its movement.
The yellow grader is parked, and the operator remains in the cab.
A man in a green shirt and camouflage hat appears in the foreground.
The man in the green shirt gestures with his hands while talking.
The man continues to speak to the camera with the grader behind him.
The man in the green shirt smiles as he finishes speaking.
The camera focus shifts back to the stationary yellow Galion grader.
A close-up view shows the rear of the yellow grader and a flat tire.
The operator, in camouflage, begins to climb out of the grader's cab.
The operator steps down from the yellow grader onto a metal step.
The operator continues to climb down from the cab towards the ground.
The operator reaches the ground and stands beside the yellow grader.
A close-up shows the operator's hands working on a part of the grader.
The operator is seen adjusting or inspecting a component of the machine.
The camera captures the operator's hands as he handles a metal part.
The operator continues to work on the yellow Galion T-400 grader.
The yellow grader sits stationary while the operator performs maintenance.
The side of the grader is shown, with the model name clearly visible.
The operator is seen standing next to the stationary yellow grader.
Three men are seen standing together in front of the yellow grader.
The three men pose for a photo in front of the Galion grader.
One of the men points towards the camera while the group poses.
